ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: nursed through an illness
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One of them lay sick with something that could have killed them, and the other tended them through it, dose by dose, until it broke.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a close call
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: Something on the land nearly did for one of them, with the other right there to see it. It comes up every time they pass the spot.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: founded a colony together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They set out together to make a new home from nothing, and were there on its first night.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a debt remembered
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One of them was tended under fire by the other, and has said out loud that they mean to pay it back.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the downpour
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They got caught out in the rain together and gave up trying to stay dry. Neither of them will say who ran first.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the snowball fight
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One snowball became a war, and the two of them still argue about who won it.
